style: Blue ballpoint on ruled notebook, matching user's level design sketches
base:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create ONE portrait game-level design drawing, like a Vietnamese designer's rough BLUE BALLPOINT PEN sketch on a slightly off-white ruled notebook page. This is a functional paper sketch for design review, NOT a Unity render or polished concept painting. Visible faint horizontal notebook lines, slightly irregular hand-drawn blue ink, simple 3/4 perspective transparent rectangular box, dashed hidden edges, very restrained hatching. All labels and arrows in the same blue pen. Keep objects large, uncluttered and understandable on a phone. Creature COghe is a small irregular soft liquid blob with a couple of short tendrils, NO face/eyes/legs, no Marvel logo. Glass is indicated by outlines only. Arrows indicating motion are hollow or simple line arrows, leaders for labels must point unambiguously at the right object. A small separate inset may show the resulting configuration; label it "Sau khi giải" so duplicate objects cannot be mistaken for a second live object. Main diagram shows initial state. Put title at top, one short subtitle for proposed order, diagram occupying middle two thirds, then two or three large legible handwritten Vietnamese sentences under "Mục tiêu:". Do not add equations, fake dimension strings, scenery, colors, game UI, HUD, photorealistic metal, random gears, or extra obstacles. Correct Vietnamese diacritics and the exact text matter. The sketch is a proposal, not proof of physics.

levels.title: Nghiêng là tới
levels.spec:
Title exactly "21 — Nghiêng là tới"; subtitle "Vị trí chơi đề xuất: 05".
Inside a simple glass box draw a shallow broad U-shaped straight trough from left to right, starting at a small grippy ledge on the left. The trough is inside the box above a safe floor, its base and low side walls have simple diagonal hatching representing slippery coating. At the right end there is a broad shallow receiving cradle with a NON-slippery base and a low end-stop wall; a round flush exit hole in the outer right glass wall is aligned with that receiving platform. Creature initially on left ledge. Large curved arrow outside box indicates tilt right-end downward; small motion arrow follows trough into receiving cradle. Make clear tilt moves entire box; slideway never flies out. Main glass box can be slightly tilted, stable reading perspective.
Only labels: "Sinh vật", "Máng trơn", "Khay bám rộng", "Lỗ thoát", "Nghiêng hộp".
Footer exact: "Mục tiêu: Nghiêng để sinh vật trượt vào khay." / "Thành máng giữ hướng, không cần phanh chính xác." / "Tới khay rồi bò ra lỗ."

levels.title: Đáp rồi chui
levels.spec:
Title "22 — Đáp rồi chui"; subtitle "Vị trí chơi đề xuất: 11".
Draw TWO small transparent boxes next to one another linked by one horizontal transparent tube. Left box: creature on a wide climbing ledge whose short hatched slippery edge is just ABOVE the left tube entrance. Show very short vertical drop arrow DOWN along inner wall into a large clear gripping ring around tube opening, flanked by two small physical guiding cheeks. The ring is below the ledge, not on the floor. Left box has safe floor and open return climb path. Tube leads into right box onto a wide receiving ledge. Right outer wall has a separate round final exit. Draw soft liquid as dashed motion outline along tube only, not extra creatures. Main creature starts before dropping.
Only labels: "Sinh vật", "Mép trơn", "Rơi ngắn", "Vành bám rộng", "Ống nối", "Lỗ thoát".
Footer: "Mục tiêu: Chỉ tới mép trơn để rơi vào vành bám." / "Bám được thì tự chảy qua ống." / "Rơi hụt có thể leo lên thử lại."

levels.title: Khớp rồi!
levels.spec:
Title "23 — Khớp rồi!"; subtitle "Vị trí chơi đề xuất: 09".
One glass cube, creature at front left on flat gripping floor. At back, a compact gear assembly: fixed source gear M at left and fixed output gear R at right, with a conspicuous missing CENTRAL idler. The SINGLE loose idler G is on a carriage parked LOWER on a short vertical rail underneath the missing central position; it has a large stationary handle on the carriage, not on a rotating tooth. An arrow UP the rail indicates pushing G to its hard stop where it meshes with both gears M and R; ghost destination outline clearly dashed, same G. Motor casing behind M labeled motor. R meshes with a vertical rack attached to a shutter covering the circular final hole on right wall. Show shutter solid closed with the hole outline dashed behind it, and upward arrow at shutter. End stop and catch drawn simply. Geometry legible, no decorative gears.
Only labels: "Sinh vật", "Nguồn quay", "Bánh G", "Tay nắm", "Cửa nâng", "Lỗ thoát".
Footer: "Mục tiêu: Đẩy bánh G vào vị trí ăn khớp." / "Bộ truyền quay và nâng cửa." / "Cửa giữ mở để sinh vật đi ra."

levels.title: Kéo ra mới qua
levels.spec:
Title "24 — Kéo ra mới qua"; subtitle "Vị trí chơi đề xuất: 14".
A simple transparent glass box with grippy floor, blob at front. Rear inner wall holds a broad solid sliding shutter on a HORIZONTAL rail, covering one round exit through outer wall; draw round hidden exit with dashed line behind shutter. To the LEFT of shutter is a clearly empty parking recess, open toward viewer so the handle remains accessible when shutter goes in. Shutter handle projects toward inside box. Arrow goes LEFT from handle/shutter into empty recess. Right end rail has solid hard-stop; no other mechanisms, no gears. Small separate inset "Sau khi giải" shows shutter parked LEFT and round exit unobstructed on right; same objects, not extra game pieces.
Labels: "Sinh vật", "Tay nắm", "Nắp che lỗ", "Hốc chứa", "Kéo sang trái", "Lỗ thoát".
Footer: "Mục tiêu: Kéo nắp sang hốc để lộ lỗ." / "Đẩy nhầm thì kéo ngược lại." / "Tay nắm luôn còn chỗ để bám."

levels.title: Hai nhịp một cửa
levels.spec:
Title "25 — Hai nhịp một cửa"; subtitle "Vị trí chơi đề xuất: 16".
One transparent box, blob at front left. A small shallow closed recess near center front contains pull handle B; it has sides/roof and a sliding lid A with its own exposed handle. Draw A initially closed, B as dashed hidden handle INSIDE this recess. Motion arrow pulls A sideways to expose B; label A prominently. From internal handle B, show a clean thin cable routed via one pulley to a SEPARATE gate covering round exit on right wall; not an electronic connection. On side, one modest inset "Sau khi mở A" shows B exposed, arrow pulling B and lifting final gate. Indicate catches with little notches. Make there be two different manipulable handles A then B, no pressure plate, no need two organisms.
Labels: "Sinh vật", "Nắp A", "Tay kéo B", "Dây kéo", "Cửa có chốt", "Lỗ thoát".
Footer: "Mục tiêu: Kéo nắp A để lộ tay nắm B." / "Kéo B để nâng cửa cuối." / "Mỗi bước có chốt giữ lại kết quả."

levels.title: Bắc một nhịp
levels.spec:
Title "26 — Bắc một nhịp"; subtitle "Vị trí chơi đề xuất: 18".
Draw glass box in simple perspective, blob on left ledge, destination ledge on right at same height, gap between them. ONE short bridge deck sits on a carriage with front-to-back rail, initially parked forward and offset from bridge gap. Large low handle faces player on front of carriage. Arrow pushes this one deck BACK into the missing gap, ghost seated outline dashed. Slippery region beneath gap lightly hatched, safe recovery floor connects back to left. A vertical fixed partition encloses destination area and has ONE opening at deck height. The same moving bridge carriage includes a thin perforated upright shutter plate at its right end; at correct carriage position the plate opening aligns with fixed partition opening and bridge connects ledges. Show this simply, not overly technical. Small inset "Sau khi ghép" clarifies one deck connecting ledges and aligned round/arched passage, with final round exit farther right in outer box wall. No second bridge, no extra gears.
Labels: "Sinh vật", "Một nhịp cầu", "Tay nắm", "Vùng trơn", "Cửa trên vách", "Lỗ thoát".
Footer: "Mục tiêu: Đẩy cầu tới chốt rồi trèo qua." / "Cầu và cửa trên vách cùng thẳng hàng." / "Rơi xuống vẫn có đường quay lại."

levels.title: Một bánh, hai việc
levels.spec:
Title "27 — Một bánh, hai việc"; subtitle "Vị trí chơi đề xuất: 21".
One transparent box with a SINGLE movable idler gear G on a long horizontal rail, stationary handle on its carriage. There are two end stations A and B, each has small fixed source/output gears with blank gap for G. A visible small motor + belt feeds the fixed input wheels at both stations. At center rail a real raised/lower shutter obstructs passage of G initially. At station A the load cable/rack lifts THIS middle shutter; at B the load raises a separate gate covering round final exit on outer right wall. Draw initial G between left station and center barrier. Arrow LEFT to station A then arrow RIGHT along track to B; label arrows 1 and 2 on this designer sketch only. The main scene must contain EXACTLY ONE solid G. A dashed circle in station B may indicate destination, not extra G. Small separate inset "Sau bước 1" shows middle barrier raised and caught, allowing same G to pass. Keep the four fixed small gears easy to distinguish from large movable G; no busy factory scenery.
Labels: "Sinh vật", "Bánh G", "Trạm A", "Trạm B", "Nắp chắn ray", "Cửa cuối", "Lỗ thoát".
Footer: "Mục tiêu: Đưa G tới A để mở đường ray." / "Dùng lại chính bánh G ở trạm B." / "Cơ quan A đã mở vẫn được giữ bằng chốt."

levels.title: Nhường đường
levels.spec:
Title "28 — Nhường đường"; subtitle "Vị trí chơi đề xuất: 23".
One transparent box on grippy floor. Blob at front left. A small cube CRATE blocks the short rail path of movable idler gear G, so carriage cannot reach gear engagement position. To front/left of the crate is an open wide parking alcove accessible from viewer; arrow1 moves crate SIDEWAYS off rail into this space. Behind/next to crate draw G on short rail with large stationary handle; arrow2 slides G along now-clear path toward two fixed gears source/output. Source has small motor; output rack lifts shutter covering round final exit on right wall. Clearly separate crate movement sideways from carriage movement along rail. Do not show pressing crate onto button: parking is just free space, not sensor. Small end stop behind obstruction if helpful. No labyrinth.
Labels: "Sinh vật", "Thùng chắn ray", "Chỗ đỗ rộng", "Bánh G", "Cửa nâng", "Lỗ thoát".
Footer: "Mục tiêu: Dời thùng để nhường đường." / "Sau đó đẩy bánh G vào bộ truyền." / "Đỗ lệch vẫn được nếu ray đã thông."

levels.title: Bạn giữ, tớ kéo
levels.spec:
Title "29 — Bạn giữ, tớ kéo"; subtitle "Vị trí chơi đề xuất: 26".
One spacious transparent glass box, no separate pipe rooms. Main diagram shows cooperation state with EXACTLY TWO small irregular blob fragments: one on broad pressure pad A far left, the other holding a stationary pull handle B far right. A small guillotine at front center, blade parked safely HIGH on two posts, indicates cutter used previously; no blood, no danger theatrics. A thin clearly drawn mechanical linkage from A to clutch at motor/winch near B. Pulling B drives cable/winch lifting gate covering round final exit at back-right. Two fragments far enough apart that they are visibly separated. A clear open reunion floor patch before final exit, circled dashed as destination, not a mechanism. Include small separate inset upper left "Trước khi tách" with ONE blob under raised guillotine and tiny inset lower right "Trước khi thoát" with ONE recombined blob near exit; these are time snapshots, not more creatures in main box.
Labels: "Máy chém", "Giữ nút A", "Kéo tay B", "Cửa có chốt", "Chỗ hợp thể", "Lỗ thoát".
Footer: "Mục tiêu: Một phần giữ A, phần kia kéo B." / "Cửa mở hết sẽ được chốt lại." / "Hợp thể trong hộp rồi mới chui ra."

levels.title: Nhà máy tí hon
levels.spec:
Title "30 — Nhà máy tí hon"; subtitle "BOSS — Vị trí chơi đề xuất: 10".
Draw ONE transparent box with ONE blob at front left, compact small machine. At left/middle fixed source gear and fixed output gear with a SINGLE intermediate gear G on a short rail parked out of mesh, large stationary handle. Source motor visible. The output rack opens SLIDING COVER of a SMALL RECESS in middle-right, revealing pull handle B hidden inside. From B draw one cable over pulley to a SEPARATE final gate covering the round exit on outer right wall. Main initial view shows G out of mesh, small cover closed, B dashed hidden. One inset "Sau khi nối G" shows cover retracted exposing B, then pulling B raises final gate. Two actions, no cutting, no pressure plate, no two creatures, no extra gates. All catches real not magical. Large clean shapes.
Labels: "Sinh vật", "Bánh G", "Nắp che B", "Tay kéo B", "Cửa cuối", "Lỗ thoát".
Footer: "Mục tiêu: Nối bánh G để lộ tay nắm B." / "Kéo B mở cửa và đưa sinh vật ra ngoài." / "Boss không hướng dẫn; thắng mở Nhà."
Tiny note below footer "Mũi tên trong bản vẽ chỉ để duyệt thiết kế."
